description: Stage-3 pass 5 (F14): prose between a path value's closer, on a line of its own, and a second closer. In a newline-framed value a closer on its own line is where the template ends a value, so the prose is text between parameters, which issue #3's negative corpus requires be rejected ("Never accept trailing free text as an argument"); no reading reads it into the value, and the attempt is rejected.
input:
<tool_call>
<function=write_file>
<parameter=path>
a.py
</parameter>
I will now write the file.
</parameter>
<parameter=content>
x
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
